By the way, you can also do interesting filters on the FASLIS information,
by providing switches. The format for the command line is:

	filename {esc}{switch1} {switch2}  ...

An illegal syntax in the switch area will show you the valid switches. eg,

	:FALIS {esc}.

is a good way to get it. RLB can probably explain each does. -kmp
